tris_note: scene only; robot is the runtime model (~39k) -> ~66k with robot, budget 100k
size_note: 6.92 MB because the monitor/tablet/plant textures are embedded; compress to KTX2/WebP in the build step

stage.note: platform, helix, ceiling ring and room props are children of S06_stage at 0.6 so the native-size robot stands beside the platform like the ref; keep the parent scale at runtime

textures: s06_monitor_a.png, s06_monitor_b.png (Codex IMG-S06, side holo monitors)
s06_tablet_n.png (Codex IMG-S06, holo tablet + small N screens)
runtime_shaders: M_Beam is additive (three.js AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false); M_Helix_Glass is transparent glass with a rim (use MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission or a fresnel shader); emissive materials need bloom
lighting: none exported; lit in three.js. Blender review look: Standard + Medium High Contrast, exposure 0, Glare bloom, haze 0.0007, DOF f/2.4 focus 12.5 m; lights (stage units, energy x0.36): helix_key, platform_glow, front_fill, robot_rim, drum_fill, ceiling_warm. L_helix_key must not light the floor (light-linked out in Blender) or it paints a hotspot in front of the platform

pose.note: left arm points at the helix, right hand forward holding the tablet; head and other joints at rest

robot.note: 3/4 presenter framing approved by Muse; apply this pose to the runtime robot

helix.note: N (S06_helix_logo, emerald M_Emissive_Logo) sits on the helix axis inside the strands' bulb; no rungs cross the N
helix.anchors_note: 7 glowing nodes on the helix right side, top to bottom = the 7 value pills (الإبداع, الجودة, الشراكة, المرونة, الشفافية, النمو, الأثر); draw the HTML connector lines from these points

ceiling_ring.note: tilted 6 deg so its top clears the frame like the ref

held_prop.note: holo tablet with N placed at the robot's right hand in the hero pose; re-parent to the hand bone at runtime if the robot animates

open_notes: taste: helix tubes read thinner/more wireframe than the ref's thick glass tube (Muse, not a blocker)
taste: ceiling ring is segmented/mechanical vs the ref's smooth glowing ring
